note: The Cypress specs, packed into balanced shards for CI. One GitHub Actions
runner per shard, each booting its own API + frontend.
WRITTEN BY scripts/pack-shards.mjs, from `durations`: each spec's time on a
CI runner, read from the Cypress summary of real runs (`measured`). Do NOT
split alphabetically or by file count: search_sort.cy.ts and
manufacturer_api_docs.cy.ts are ~300x apart, and the job is only as fast as
its slowest shard. `estimate` is the sum of a shard's durations, kept so the
balance is reviewable in a diff.
Refresh when the shards drift apart in CI (every new gear type lengthens the
per-type loops): `npm run shards:pack -- --from-run <run id>` with a green
run's id. A spec takes its time only from a run it PASSED in, since a failing
spec's time is mostly retries. `--shards N` changes the count.
Packed 2026-10-22 from the leashes PR's run, with gear_cards, gear_detail
and isa_warnings from run 39645502359 (pre-leashes): they failed on the
leashes run, so their times are ~10% low until a green leashes run refreshes
them. search_sort is alone on its shard and sets the floor (~5:42).
EVERY spec in cypress/e2e/ must appear in exactly one shard. A spec left out
would silently stop running while CI stayed green, so
scripts/check-shards.mjs enforces it — run by `npm run test:unit` and by
CI's shard-planning job. Adding a spec means adding it to a shard here (by
hand, or by running the packer, which times an unmeasured spec at 0:30).
